/.title: Corrections Pest Reference: Jail and Prison Pest Rules
/.description: National reference mapping federal, state, and agency pest control requirements for jails, prisons, and immigration detention. Primary-source anchored.

/authorities/.title: Pest Control Authorities Index: Corrections
/authorities/.description: Index of every authority on this reference, grouped by class: federal regulators, detention standards, state regulators, statutes, and local health rules.

/state-jail-standards/.title: State Jail Standards on Pests: 30-State Comparison
/state-jail-standards/.description: Pest and vermin provisions of the jail standards of 30 states, quoted from each primary source, with frequency, provider, and legal force side by side.

/about/.title: About Trenton S. Frazer, BCE
/about/.description: About this national reference on pest control in jails, prisons, and detention facilities, maintained by Trenton S. Frazer, Board Certified Entomologist.

/methodology/.title: Methodology: Source Tiers and Verification
/methodology/.description: Source tier hierarchy, confidence ratings, and verification discipline behind every fact on this reference, plus the open questions under verification.

/consulting/.title: Pest Program Consulting for Jails and Prisons
/consulting/.description: Frazer Applied Entomology offers facility pest program assessment, contract and scope review, Entomologist of Record work, and expert witness services.

/tools/.title: Free Pest Control Tools for Jails and Prisons
/tools/.description: Free tools built from the primary sources: a compliance map and checklist, a pest grievance worksheet and log, a model policy, and a model scope of work.

/tools/compliance-map/.title: Pest Compliance Map for Jails and Prisons
/tools/compliance-map/.description: Choose a facility profile in any of 30 states to see which pest control authorities apply, the record that shows each was met, and how often.

/tools/scope-of-work/.title: Model Pest Management Scope of Work for Jails
/tools/scope-of-work/.description: Free model contract language for a correctional facility pest management scope of work, filled in for your state, with a Word download for each state.

/tools/pest-control-policy/.title: Model Pest Control Policy for Jails and Prisons
/tools/pest-control-policy/.description: Free model written pest control policy for a jail, prison, or detention facility, filled in for your state, with a Word download for each state.

/risk-pools/.title: Jail Pest Control Exposure for Risk Pools, Insurers
/risk-pools/.description: How a pest grievance in a jail becomes a claim, three questions to ask a member jail, and the free tools that answer them. For risk pools and insurers.

/tools/vermin-grievance-file/.title: Vermin Grievance File: Eight Pest Grievance Questions
/tools/vermin-grievance-file/.description: Printable worksheet pairing the eight questions plaintiff's counsel asks about a jail vermin grievance with the record that answers each one.

/tools/grievance-loop/.title: Pest Grievance Log: Grievance-to-Work-Order Loop
/tools/grievance-loop/.description: Printable log template for jails and prisons that ties each pest grievance to its work order, response, follow-up check, and answer.

/authorities/arkansas-12-car-50-506-lice.title: 12 CAR 50-506: Arkansas Lice and Pests at Intake
/authorities/arkansas-12-car-50-506-lice.description: Arkansas Minimum Standards for Adult Criminal Detention Facilities, 12 CAR 50-506: pests addressed only at intake, with delousing. Verbatim text.

/authorities/bop-p1614-01-occupational-s.title: BOP P1614.01 Section 47: Prison Pest Control
/authorities/bop-p1614-01-occupational-s.description: Pest control provisions of Federal Bureau of Prisons Program Statement 1614.01, Occupational Safety, Section 47. Verbatim text and the records it expects.

/authorities/bop-p4700-08-food-service-m.title: BOP P4700.08 Food Service: Rodent and Insect Control
/authorities/bop-p4700-08-food-service-m.description: Rodent and insect control provisions of Federal Bureau of Prisons Program Statement 4700.08, Food Service Manual, for prison kitchens. Verbatim text.

/authorities/california-15-ccr-1212-verm.title: 15 CCR 1212 Vermin Control: California Jail Standards
/authorities/california-15-ccr-1212-verm.description: California 15 CCR 1212 (infested persons) and 1264 (clothing); jail facility pest control comes only through the Retail Food Code for kitchens. Verbatim.

/authorities/colorado-jail-standards-top.title: Colorado Jail Standards Topic O: Pest and Vermin Policy
/authorities/colorado-jail-standards-top.description: Colorado jail standards, Topic O, call for a policy to mitigate and respond to pest and vermin control issues in county jails. Verbatim text and records.

/authorities/fda-food-code-2022/.title: FDA Food Code 2022: Correctional Kitchen Pest Control
/authorities/fda-food-code-2022/.description: Pest control text of FDA Food Code 2022 sections 6-501.111 and 6-202.13 as it applies to jail and prison food service. Quoted from the primary source.

/authorities/florida-model-jail-standard.title: Florida Model Jail Standards 14.12: Insects, Rodents
/authorities/florida-model-jail-standard.description: Text of Florida Model Jail Standards 14.12 on insect and rodent control in county jails, adopted under Fla. Stat. 951.23. Quoted from the source.

/authorities/ice-nds-2019-environmental-.title: ICE NDS 2019 Standard 1.1: Pests and Vermin
/authorities/ice-nds-2019-environmental-.description: Pests and vermin provisions of ICE National Detention Standards 2019, Standard 1.1 Environmental Health and Safety. Verbatim text and records.

/authorities/ice-nds-2019-food-service/.title: ICE NDS 2019 Standard 4.1: Food Service Pest Control
/authorities/ice-nds-2019-food-service/.description: Pest control provisions of ICE National Detention Standards 2019, Standard 4.1 Food Service, for detention food service. Verbatim text and records.

/authorities/ice-pbnds-2011-environmenta.title: ICE PBNDS 2011 Standard 1.2: Monthly Pest Inspections
/authorities/ice-pbnds-2011-environmenta.description: Monthly licensed pest control inspection provisions of ICE PBNDS 2011, Standard 1.2 Environmental Health and Safety. Primary-source text and records.

/authorities/ice-pbnds-2011-food-service.title: ICE PBNDS 2011 Standard 4.1: Food Service Pest Control
/authorities/ice-pbnds-2011-food-service.description: Pest control provisions of ICE PBNDS 2011, Standard 4.1 Food Service, for detention food service. Quoted from the primary source, with records.

/authorities/idaho-jail-standards-10-03/.title: Idaho Jail Standards 10.03: Vermin and Pest Plan
/authorities/idaho-jail-standards-10-03/.description: Idaho Sheriffs' Association Jail Standards 10.03: a vermin and pest control plan with monthly inspections and licensed fumigation. Verbatim text.

/authorities/illinois-20-iac-701-120-pes.title: 20 Ill. Adm. Code 701.120(g): Illinois Jail Pests
/authorities/illinois-20-iac-701-120-pes.description: Illinois county jail standards, 20 Ill. Adm. Code 701.120(g): a continuous, documented insect and rodent program, body pests, 16-mesh screening. Verbatim.

/authorities/indiana-210-iac-3-1-9-insec.title: 210 IAC 3-1-9(d): Indiana Jail Weekly Pest Inspection
/authorities/indiana-210-iac-3-1-9-insec.description: Indiana county jail standards, 210 IAC 3-1-9(d): weekly inspection for insects and rodents and licensed extermination as often as necessary. Verbatim text.

/authorities/iowa-201-iac-50-14-pest-fre.title: 201 IAC 50.14(1)(a)(2): Iowa Jail Pest-Free Condition
/authorities/iowa-201-iac-50-14-pest-fre.description: Iowa jail standards, 201 IAC 50.14(1)(a)(2): a pest-free jail, chemicals applied by certified applicators, no direct exposure of prisoners or staff.

/authorities/kentucky-501-kar-3-080-verm.title: 501 KAR 3:080: Kentucky Jail Vermin and Pest Control
/authorities/kentucky-501-kar-3-080-verm.description: Kentucky full-service jail standards, 501 KAR 3:080 Section 1(1): the jailer provides for control of vermin and pests; preventive maintenance plan. Verbatim.

/authorities/lexipol-custody-manual-poli.title: Lexipol Custody Manual Policy 805: Pest Control
/authorities/lexipol-custody-manual-poli.description: Lexipol Custody Manual Policy 805, Vermin and Pest Control: monthly licensed inspection, treatment of infested inmates, and secured storage. By section.

/authorities/maryland-comar-12-14-03-05-.title: COMAR 12.14.03.05: Maryland Quarterly Jail Pest Control
/authorities/maryland-comar-12-14-03-05-.description: Maryland adult detention center standards, COMAR 12.14.03.05A(3)(b): a written housekeeping policy for quarterly vermin and pest control. Verbatim text.

/authorities/massachusetts-103-cmr-974-0.title: 103 CMR 974.06: Massachusetts Insect and Rodent Control
/authorities/massachusetts-103-cmr-974-0.description: Massachusetts 103 CMR 974.06: a written vermin and pest policy and extermination by a licensed person, with DPH 105 CMR 451.361. Verbatim text.

/authorities/michigan-r-791-727-vermin-p.title: Michigan R 791.727: Jail Vermin and Pest Control Plan
/authorities/michigan-r-791-727-vermin-p.description: Michigan Department of Corrections jail and lockup rule R 791.727: a written vermin and pest control plan with monthly inspections. Verbatim text.

/authorities/minnesota-rule-2911-7500-ve.title: Minnesota Rules 2911.7500: Jail Vermin and Pest Plan
/authorities/minnesota-rule-2911-7500-ve.description: Minnesota Rules 2911.7500: a written plan for control and elimination of vermin and pests in every jail. Verbatim text, legal force, pending revision.

/authorities/montana-jail-standards-10-0.title: Montana Jail Standards 10.01: Vermin and Pest Control
/authorities/montana-jail-standards-10-0.description: Montana Jail Standards, Chapter 10 Sanitation and Hygiene, Standard 10.01: vermin and pests are controlled. Verbatim text and the records that show it.

/authorities/nevada-nac-211-430-vermin-c.title: Nevada NAC 211.430: Jail Vermin Control

/authorities/new-jersey-njac-10a-31-11-5.title: N.J.A.C. 10A:31-11.5: New Jersey Jail Pest Control
/authorities/new-jersey-njac-10a-31-11-5.description: N.J.A.C. 10A:31-11.5: licensed pest control professionals at least monthly, plus integrated pest management, in adult county correctional facilities.

/authorities/new-mexico-nmac-adps-ss-06/.title: New Mexico ADPS SS-06: Jail Vermin and Pest Plan
/authorities/new-mexico-nmac-adps-ss-06/.description: New Mexico Adult Detention Professional Standards SS-06: a written vermin and pest control plan with monthly inspection by a licensed exterminator.

/authorities/new-york-10-nycrr-14-1-160-.title: 10 NYCRR 14-1.160: New York Jail Kitchen Insect Control

/authorities/new-york-9-nycrr-7015-2-ins.title: 9 NYCRR 7015.2(e): New York Insect and Rodent Control
/authorities/new-york-9-nycrr-7015-2-ins.description: New York Commission of Correction 9 NYCRR 7015.2(e): each local correctional facility develops procedures to eliminate insect and rodent infestation.

/authorities/new-york-9-nycrr-7032-griev.title: 9 NYCRR Part 7032: New York Pest Grievance Deadlines
/authorities/new-york-9-nycrr-7032-griev.description: New York 9 NYCRR Part 7032: five days to file, a written determination in five business days, and appeal, applied to pest grievances. Verbatim text.

/authorities/new-york-ecl-33-6-nycrr-325.title: New York ECL Article 33: Pesticides Applied in Jails
/authorities/new-york-ecl-33-6-nycrr-325.description: New York ECL Article 33 and 6 NYCRR Part 325 on certification, registration, and records for pesticides applied in a jail. Verbatim text and records.

/authorities/new-york-nyssa-corrections-.title: NYSSA Standards 118 and 119: Jail Sanitation and Pests
/authorities/new-york-nyssa-corrections-.description: New York State Sheriffs' Association accreditation Standards 118 and 119: monthly sanitation inspections and a kitchen free of rodents and insects.

/authorities/north-carolina-15a-ncac-18a.title: 15A NCAC 18A .1515: North Carolina Jail Vermin Control
/authorities/north-carolina-15a-ncac-18a.description: North Carolina jail standards adopt 15A NCAC 18A .1515: effective measures against flies, rodents and vermin, 16-mesh screening. Verbatim text.

/authorities/ohio-5120-1-8-05-jail-sanit.title: Ohio 5120:1-8-05: Jail Sanitation, Vermin Inspections
/authorities/ohio-5120-1-8-05-jail-sanit.description: Ohio Adm.Code 5120:1-8-05, sanitation and environmental conditions in full service jails, with monthly vermin inspections. Quoted from the source.

/authorities/oklahoma-oac-310-670-5-6-pe.title: Oklahoma OAC 310:670-5-6(19): Jail Pest Control
/authorities/oklahoma-oac-310-670-5-6-pe.description: Oklahoma jail standards, OAC 310:670-5-6(19): conducive conditions eliminated, and licensed pest control professionals contracted on a schedule. Verbatim.

/authorities/oregon-ors-169-076-local-co.title: ORS 169.076(2)(g): Oregon Jail Vermin Control Policy

/authorities/oregon-ossa-jail-standards-.title: Oregon Jail Standards H-201: Sanitation Plan and Vermin
/authorities/oregon-ossa-jail-standards-.description: Oregon State Sheriffs' Association Oregon Jail Standards, H-201 Sanitation Plan, place vermin control inside the cleaning plan. Recorded by identifier.

/authorities/osha-1910-141-sanitation/.title: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.141(a)(5): Vermin Control in Jails
/authorities/osha-1910-141-sanitation/.description: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.141 paragraphs (a)(1) Scope and (a)(5) Vermin control, as applied to jail and prison workplaces. Quoted from the primary source.

/authorities/pennsylvania-37-pa-code-95-.title: 37 Pa. Code 95.248(2): Pennsylvania Prison Pest Control
/authorities/pennsylvania-37-pa-code-95-.description: Pennsylvania county prison requirements, 37 Pa. Code 95.248(2): monthly vermin and pest control by a qualified person, with documentation. Verbatim text.

/authorities/slco-health-regulation-34-c.title: Salt Lake County Health Regulation #34: Jail Pests

/authorities/south-carolina-jail-standar.title: South Carolina Standard 3003: Vermin, Insects, Pests

/authorities/tennessee-tci-1400-01-09-ve.title: Tennessee TCI Rule 1400-01-.09(5): Jail Pest Control

/authorities/texas-tcjs-37-tac-261-147-v.title: 37 TAC 261.147: Texas Jail Vermin Control Rule

/authorities/usms-fpbds-v12/.title: USMS FPBDS Version 12, F.2.4: Monthly Pest Inspections

/authorities/utah-grama-correctional-fac.title: Utah Code 63G-2-301: Public Jail Pest Records

/authorities/utah-r392-100-food-service-.title: Utah R392-100 Food Service Sanitation: Jail Kitchens
/authorities/utah-r392-100-food-service-.description: Utah Administrative Code R392-100, Food Service Sanitation, which adopts the 2022 FDA Food Code, as applied to jail and prison kitchens. Source text.

/authorities/utah-r68-7-pesticide-applic.title: Utah R68-7 Pesticide Applicator Licensing: Jails
/authorities/utah-r68-7-pesticide-applic.description: Utah Administrative Code R68-7, the Utah Pesticide Control Rule, as it applies to licensed applicators in jails and prisons. Quoted from the source.

/authorities/utah-udc-correctional-stand.title: Utah Correctional Standards FY27: Pest and Vermin
/authorities/utah-udc-correctional-stand.description: Utah Department of Corrections standards E-03, G-04, G-05, and I-01(F) for secure facilities: pest, vermin, and food service inspection. Source text.

/authorities/virginia-6vac15-40-1150-ver.title: Virginia 6VAC15-40-1150: Jail Vermin and Pest Control
/authorities/virginia-6vac15-40-1150-ver.description: Virginia 6VAC15-40-1150 for jails and lockups: vermin and pest control by quarterly licensed service. Quoted from the primary source, with records.

/authorities/washington-rcw-70-48-071-ja.title: RCW 70.48.071: Washington Jail Operating Standards
/authorities/washington-rcw-70-48-071-ja.description: Washington's City and County Jails Act: each jail adopts operating standards and runs by them. Verbatim text and what it means for pest control policy.

/authorities/washington-waspc-jail-accre.title: WASPC Jail Accreditation 20.1: Washington Pest Control
/authorities/washington-waspc-jail-accre.description: Washington Association of Sheriffs and Police Chiefs jail accreditation standard 20.1: policy or procedures governing pest control. Verbatim text.

/authorities/wisconsin-doc-350-12-vermin.title: Wisconsin DOC 350.12(10): Jail Vermin and Pest Program
/authorities/wisconsin-doc-350-12-vermin.description: Wisconsin Administrative Code DOC 350.12(10): vermin and pests controlled with an effective, documented program; locked storage of poisons. Verbatim.
